acceptance.definition: eligible (supported, >=4 keys) natural cases only. validObservedAccepted: the intended word in its own language; wrongAlternativeAccepted: the converted candidate of a wrong copy (recovery potential); wrongObservedAccepted: the wrong-layout text itself accepted by the observed language (blocks correction). stem = experiment-002 stem lexicon on canonical keys; control = Hunspell noPfxSfx; full = Hunspell original aff; Hunspell queries keep the exact case

ambiguity.rule: shared label for all nine methods: stem-both OR noPfxSfx-both OR full-both on the actual case-preserved candidate pair; any Correct on a labelled case is unsafe and never a recovery. addedBeyondStem counts labels added by the Hunspell engines over the experiment-002 stem label

challenge.intent: every challenge token is labelled Keep; any Correct is an unsafe change. Same fixtures, noise sequence and ambiguous stem keys as experiment 002: noise excludes only the old full stem lexicons, not Hunspell acceptance, so cases are not chosen with the new engines. Texts are held in memory only for the Hunspell query. No heuristic gates are derived from these results
challenge.noiseRule: unchanged from experiment 002: attempt i: d = SHA-256(noise_seed || 0x00 || ASCII decimal i), us first, ru continues the counter; length = 4 + d[0] mod 13; key j = d[1+j] mod 33; keys in either old full stem lexicon and duplicates rejected; at most 100000 attempts in total

definitions: valid = natural new-block token, intent Keep, native layout; wrong = synthetic copy of a native letter-only token typed in the other layout, case retained; Hunspell membership: observed = the exact typed text in the typed layout's language, alternative = convertLayout(text) in the other language, only for supported cases with >=4 keys; ambiguous = shared label (see ambiguity.rule); length = canonical keys if supported, else UTF-16 length; unique types = first occurrence per (language, role, exact text); membership slices are relative to the case's typed layout. hunspellNoPfxSfx is NOT no-morphology: case, compounds and other directives remain

dictionaries.processing: unchanged experiment-002 stem baseline: Hunspell .dic stems via experiment-001 helpers, lowercase letter-only 1..32, affixes not expanded; stemExact = all approved stem keys

hypothesisEvidence.M1: acceptance.*.validObservedAccepted/wrongAlternativeAccepted full vs control gains/losses; pairwise.hunspellFull.vsHunspellNoPfxSfx added recoveries and added unsafe changes
hypothesisEvidence.M2: pairwise.hunspellFull.vsTwoScore and methods.hunspellFull vs methods.twoScore recovered and unsafe totals
hypothesisEvidence.M4: pairwise.morphThenModel.vsHunspellFull added recoveries vs added unsafe changes; occurrences.byFullMorphMembership.neither
hypothesisEvidence.verdict: not computed by this tool; the result report states supported/refuted/inconclusive

latency.methodology: warm, single thread, new-block natural cases: every k-th case, at most 2000 (k = max(1, cases/2000)). First the cached Hunspell membership and every live decision are checked to equal the evaluated ones. One warm-up pass; pNN = nearest-rank percentile over cases of the mean of 32 back-to-back calls; batchedMeanNs = one timer over 32 passes. fullDecisionPaths include canonicalizeToken, convertLayout and direct uncached Hunspell_spell (no evaluation cache); prenormalizedLookups exclude normalization and conversion. Not single-keystroke latency

limitations: same-source new block, not new-domain independence; Tatoeba example sentences, not user input; Hunspell applies its own normalization (case rules, trailing-period handling, IGNORE/ICONV) inside spell; control removes only PFX/SFX rows; oracle token boundaries; repeated words are not independent trials and no confidence is claimed; resource sizes are file sizes, not RSS

expectedPrecision.label: analytic scenario, not deployment precision: assumes the natural valid mix and the synthetic wrong-layout mix represent a stream with the given wrong-layout prevalence, i.e. that the measured conditional rates r, u, f transfer to that stream; the point value is a mixture identity over these marginal rates, while repeated words are not independent trials, so no confidence interval is given

rawChangeTotals.definition: every Correct decision on natural valid-intent or wrong-intent occurrences, ignoring the ambiguity label; for transparency only, ambiguous changes remain unsafe

featureCache.scope: evaluation-only cache of Hunspell pair membership keyed by (typed layout, exact text); decisions are identical to uncached queries (checked on the latency sample); latency is measured without this cache

naturalTokens.typeContract: experiment 003 unique types are (language, role, exact case-preserved text) for every method, unlike the canonical-key types of experiment 002. Protocol 003 explicitly preserves case: Hunspell membership depends on case, so canonical types would merge case variants with different outcomes. Per-language validTypes/wrongTypes above keep the experiment-002 canonical definition

pairwise.definition: paired over identical cases with the shared ambiguity label: addedRecoveries = method Recovered and baseline not; lostRecoveries = reverse; addedUnsafeChanges = method unsafe (false change, wrong conversion or ambiguous change) and baseline not; preventedUnsafeChanges = reverse

thresholds.calibration: none; fixed by protocol from experiment 001

protocol.validation: exact deep match with the frozen protocol 003 document

resources.boundary: aff/dic and library sizes are file sizes, not RSS; Hunspell builds its own in-memory tables; process RSS and load wall are measured only externally on separate --probe children. Dictionaries and the library are local development inputs, not part of an application bundle

en.controlVerified: control aff bytes equal deterministic removal of exact PFX/SFX rows

ru.controlVerified: control aff bytes equal deterministic removal of exact PFX/SFX rows

hunspell.linkage: installed system shared library, dynamically linked; verified by dladdr(&Hunspell_create) canonical path, size and SHA-256 before any Hunspell_create; not redistributed, not part of the application bundle

scope: local evaluation only; aggregate counts, hashes, sizes and timings; no words, sentences, IDs or paths; automatic input stays disabled

reservedOldBlock.use: reserved diagnostic set; not evaluated; only type overlap counts

selection.independence: new block of the same pinned Tatoeba snapshot, seed, dedup and rank as experiment 002: sentence IDs and exact texts are disjoint from the reserved block, but source, authors, templates and vocabulary are shared and correlated; not new-domain independence

reservedOldBlock.use: reserved diagnostic set; not evaluated; only type overlap counts

sources.verified: protocol 003, all three manifests, all source/aff/control/notice sizes and SHA-256, the loaded Hunspell library and the control derivation were verified before any parsing or Hunspell_create; aff/dic were re-hashed after Hunspell_create; morphology dic equals the approved experiment-001 dictionary
